scanner.title: Scanner Input
whereToLook: Make sure you created one Scanner object using System.in before you try to read any input.
Each prompt must be printed before you call the matching Scanner read method.
Use nextLine() for names and nextInt() for scores. After nextInt(), call nextLine() once to throw away the leftover newline before reading the next name.

conditionals.title: Comparing the Three Scores
whereToLook: You need to compare all three scores against each other, not just the first two.
Use if / else if / else statements to figure out which astronaut has the highest, second highest, and third highest score.
Test your logic with the highest score in each of the three input positions, not just the first one.

output.title: Displaying the Results
whereToLook: Print the results using the exact wording shown in the README: "Highest score: ", "Second highest score: ", and "Third highest score: ".
Use the name variables you stored from input in your output. Do not type an astronaut's name directly into the print statement.
Print the three result lines after you have read and compared all three astronauts, not in between.

validation.title: Checking the Scores
whereToLook: Read all six inputs first, then check the scores.
A score is invalid if it is below 0 or above 100; || lets one condition check both sides.
If any score is invalid, print only the invalid message: no ranking and no average.

average.title: Crew Average
whereToLook: Add the three scores and divide by 3.0, not 3, so the result keeps its decimals.
Display the average with printf and %.2f.
Print the average after the three ranking lines.
